svg.title: Snubber branch inductance and PCB placement

path.aria-label: A real snubber includes the complete outgoing and return path
Lbranch includes component ESL, pads, traces and the return.
0 / 1 / 5 / 20 / 100 nH: assumed cases, not part data.
Compact branch at the two device pins
Remote branch with a large current loop
Keep both connections short and close together. A remote ground via can defeat close component placement.
Provide thermal copper for R without enlarging the high-frequency loop; keep the voltage probe loop small too.
